messages:
kevin: FYI, hit a weird flurry of GPU node join failures in eu-north-1 after the new kms key-policy roll earlier today :warning:
natalie: noticed autoscaler spamming retries, saw a drop in available capacity for a few pools around 09:40 UTC
sre-anna: agent traces show KMS:Decrypt returned AccessDenied and then nodes abort join. also saw a couple of keystore proxy 5xxs during the same window
devin: which key policy change? i saw a PR but not the diff
security-rahul: i pushed a tighter key policy to require kms:ViaService and sourceVpc condition for decrypts to limit cross-region misuse. rolled at 09:30 UTC with no canary because this was a low-risk key.
kevin: that aligns. some eu-north warm nodes were created from older images that don't set the sourceVpc attribute on ephemeral role sessions, so decrypts get rejected
natalie: impact: ~90 failed joins, autoscaler queued ~30 extra on-demand attempts. we fell back for a few shards so tail latency increased briefly for internal eval jobs
sre-anna: rough cost: 30 on-demand * 1h avg * $2/hr = ~$60 plus spot churn. not huge but could be worse if not caught
natalie: we should avoid manual keystore exceptions, but need quick fix to restore capacity. suggestions?
security-rahul: options: 1) temporary allowlist of the warmpool principal ARNs for this key (short TTL) 2) revert key-policy to previous state and re-roll with canary/deployment gate 3) route unknown sessions through regional keystore proxy that still has access
devin: 2 is safest long-term. for immediate recovery i'd prefer (1) with short TTL while we backfill sessions/images to include sourceVpc info
kevin: +1 on allowlist short window. can we automate a TTL so human forgets aren't dangerous?
ops-bot: created ticket INF-4719: "temp allowlist for kms key to restore warmpool joins". Draft PR: https://git.internal/infra/kms/ps/212
sre-anna: i'll start the backfill job to update onboarding images and the role-session generator to include sourceVpc. job id: onboarding-job/432
natalie: after allowlist we should run a quick health canary across regions and add alert for KMS:Decrypt rate >5x baseline to page on-call
natalie: also add deploy gating: require health-check of warm pool join metric for 10m before flip
security-rahul: applied allowlist for warmpool principals at 09:44 UTC, TTL 20m. logged principals and created audit entry
kevin: nodes recovering, warmpool capacity restored at 09:48 UTC. good catch all
devin: follow-ups: add a pre-deploy simulation that spins a fake warmpool join through the new key policy, add a short-lived allowlist doc to runbook/keystore-ops.md, and add a pager threshold for KMS decrypt spikes
sre-anna: extracting join-failure logs and cost delta for postmortem-lite, will drop graphs in #postmortems
natalie: thanks. i'll coordinate with security-rahul on the RFC for key-policy rollout cadence and canary requirements
kevin: closing once postmortem link posted. :thumbsup:
